_: The film, as data. Nothing here is a time in seconds: every shot is placed
and measured in BEATS, and film/build.py turns beats into frames with
which is an integer, which is the whole reason for those two numbers. A cut
therefore lands on an exact frame that is also an exact beat of the score,
and the score is generated from the same tempo, so the two cannot drift.
Source clips are listed in film/SOURCES.md with the result of the identity
scan that cleared each one. Clips not listed there were rejected and must
not be added here without a fresh scan.
